title: Skin Care for Bhubaneswar Weather: A Routine for Fierce Summers, Humid Monsoons and Mild Winters
ex: Very hot summers, a humid monsoon, stormy post-monsoon weeks and a short dry winter: a simple skin care routine for people living in Bhubaneswar.
rt: Skin Care for Bhubaneswar Weather by Season | Mirc Glow
rd: Skin care for Bhubaneswar weather: sun care for heatwave summers, light layers in the humid monsoon and a richer night routine for the short dry winter.
quick: Bhubaneswar has a very hot summer from about March to June, a humid monsoon to September, warm sticky weeks in October and November and a short dry winter. Keep a gentle face wash and broad-spectrum sunscreen all year, use light layers and half the night cream in the hot and wet months, and a fuller night cream in winter.
